auth.signInSubtitle: Manage your servers, hosting and billing in one place.
auth.twoFactorPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
auth.registerSubtitle: One account manages every service you buy.
auth.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of service and the acceptable use policy.
auth.checkYourEmailBody: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Your account is created; verify the address to start ordering.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter the address on the account and we will send a reset link.
auth.forgotSent: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You can sign in with it now.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is missing its token. Request a new one.

errors.auth.invalid_credentials: These credentials do not match our records.
errors.auth.account_locked: This account is temporarily locked after repeated failed sign-in attempts.
errors.auth.two_factor_required: A two-factor code is required to complete sign-in.
errors.auth.forbidden: You are not permitted to perform this action.
errors.auth.csrf_token_mismatch: Your session expired. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.resource.not_found: The requested resource does not exist.
errors.server.error: Something went wrong on our side.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.pageNotFoundBody: The address you opened does not match anything in the portal.

account.accountsSubtitle: The accounts you can order and be invoiced under.
account.noAccounts: No billing account is linked to this user yet.
account.securitySubtitle: The state of the controls protecting this account.
account.profileSubtitle: How you appear and how the platform speaks to you.
account.name: Full name
account.emailImmutable: Contact support to change the address on the account.
account.timezoneHint: An IANA name, such as Asia/Kuwait.
account.verifyEmailBody: Ordering is available once the address on this account is verified. Check your inbox for the link we sent.

security.subtitle: Second factor, password, and where your account is signed in.
security.twoFactorSubtitle: A code from your authenticator, in addition to your password.
security.twoFactorWhy: A password alone can be phished or reused. A second factor means a stolen password is not enough on its own.
security.twoFactorActive: Your account asks for a code from your authenticator at every sign-in.
security.twoFactorStepScan: Open your authenticator app and add a new account.
security.twoFactorStepManual: Enter this key if the app cannot scan a code:
security.twoFactorStepConfirm: Enter the six-digit code the app shows, to confirm it works.
security.disableTwoFactorHint: Your password is required so that a stolen session cannot remove this protection.
security.regenerateHint: The previous codes stop working as soon as new ones are issued.
security.recoveryCodesWarning: Each code works once, and this is the only time they are shown. Keep them somewhere you can reach without this account.
security.passwordSubtitle: Change the password used to sign in.
security.passwordRevokesSessions: Changing your password signs out every other device and revokes every API token.
security.sessionsSubtitle: Every browser session currently signed in to this account.
security.activitySubtitle: Recent attempts, successful or not. An attempt you do not recognise is worth acting on.

catalogue.subtitle: What you can buy, priced in your account's currency.
catalogue.empty: Nothing is on sale in this category yet.
catalogue.noPriceInCurrency: Not priced in your account's currency.
catalogue.couponHint: Optional. Applied when the order is placed, consumed when it is paid.
catalogue.priceIsServerSide: The price is resolved on the server from the plan you chose. Nothing on this page can change it.

invoices.subtitle: Issued invoices and what is still owed.
invoices.noCreditToApply: There is no credit in this invoice's currency to apply. Credit is never converted between currencies.
invoices.creditWillNotCoverAll: Your credit does not cover the whole invoice. The rest stays payable by card.

subscriptions.subtitle: What renews, and when.
subscriptions.cancelWarning: It will run until {{date}}, which you have already paid for, and will not renew after that.
subscriptions.cancelNowWarning: It stops now. The rest of the period you have paid for is not refunded, and the servers it pays for stop serving immediately.
subscriptions.dataWarning: Whatever is on the servers it pays for is kept for {{days}} days after it stops, and destroyed once that time is up. Take a copy of anything you still need before then.
subscriptions.cancelConfirmLabel: Type the subscription reference below to confirm
subscriptions.endNowOption: End it now instead of at {{date}}

reinstall.title: Reinstall {{hostname}}
reinstall.warning: The server disk will be replaced. Existing data may be permanently lost.
reinstall.advice: Take a backup first if there is anything on this server you still need. The address, the specification and the hostname stay the same.
reinstall.started: The rebuild has been queued. This page will show its progress.

reinstallState.needs_review: The rebuild stopped and our team is looking at it
reinstallState.indeterminate: The rebuild is unconfirmed and our team is looking at it

reinstall.title: Reinstall server {{serial}}
reinstall.warning: Reinstalling this server will erase the installed operating system and may permanently destroy data on the machine.
reinstall.advice: The machine keeps its address, its hardware and its hostname. Everything on its disks is replaced. A rebuild takes tens of minutes and the server is offline throughout.
reinstall.phraseLabel: Type the serial number to confirm

reinstallState.hardware_unavailable: The machine could not be reached, so nothing was changed
reinstallState.provisioning_timeout: The install did not report back and our team is looking at it
reinstallState.indeterminate: The rebuild is unconfirmed and our team is looking at it
reinstallState.needs_review: The rebuild stopped and our team is looking at it

ips.subtitle: Addresses assigned to your services.
ips.reverseDnsHint: Published out of band. The change is queued, not immediate.

wallet.subtitle: Stored credit on your account.
wallet.howItFills: Credit arrives when a payment exceeds what was owed, or when support adds it. You cannot top it up directly.

tokens.subtitle: Credentials for the API, bound to this account.
tokens.createSubtitle: Shown once, when it is created.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.shownOnce: This is the only time it is shown. It cannot be retrieved again.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Every account on the platform.
customers.name: Account
customers.searchHint: Name, billing address, or account id.
customers.suspendExplains: Suspension stops the account buying anything more. It does not stop a running service — that is a separate, deliberate act.

provisioning.title: Provisioning queue
provisioning.subtitle: What the platform is building, and what it could not.
provisioning.needsReviewBody: A timed-out job is never retried automatically: the platform stopped waiting, which is not the same as the provider having stopped. Each of these needs a decision.
provisioning.retryBody: Only for a failure whose cause is gone — a cluster that now has room, a control panel that is back. The platform refuses a job that already built something, and any rebuild that has already destroyed data.
provisioning.retryEvidenceHint: Recorded in the audit trail. “pve-kw-04 was added this morning and has 96 free cores”, not “trying again”.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.subtitle: Capacity as the scheduler sees it, not as the hardware advertises it.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Every transaction, and refunds.
payments.refundSubtitle: Amount in the minor unit of {{currency}}.
payments.refundIsRecorded: The refund records who issued it. The platform refuses to refund more than was captured, however many operators press this at once.

operations.title: Rebuilds
operations.subtitle: Every reinstall the platform has run, and the ones nobody can settle.
operations.onlyWaiting: Only the ones waiting for a person
operations.confirmBody: The platform could not verify this rebuild for itself. Confirm it only from what you saw at the hypervisor or the console — the customer is told, and this becomes the record.
operations.abandonBody: This says the rebuild did not finish. The machine is left as it is; nothing here touches a hypervisor or a controller.
operations.evidenceHint: Recorded in the audit trail. “VM 910 on pve-kw-03 is running Rocky 10 and answering on port 22”, not “looks fine”.

drift.title: Drift
drift.subtitle: Where the platform's records and a provider's reality disagree.
drift.resolveBody: This says the disagreement is gone. Nothing here changes a provider — if the machine is still missing, it is still missing after you press this.
drift.resolutionHint: Recorded in the audit trail, and read by the next person who opens this row.

kinds.orphan_at_provider: The provider has it and nothing claims it
kinds.state_mismatch: The two disagree about what it is doing
kinds.spec_mismatch: The two disagree about how big it is

support.title: Support queue
support.subtitle: Worst first, longest untouched first within that.
support.sendAsNote: Internal note — the customer will not see this
support.noteWarning: This will not be sent to the customer, and it does not move the ticket to their turn. The clock on their question keeps running.
support.reopenedTimes: This ticket has been reopened {{count}} time(s). It may not have been fixed.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.subtitle: Where each secret lives, whether the controller has it, and whether it has ever worked. Never the secret itself.
credentials.neverPaste: Do not paste the secret. Enter the NAME of the variable that holds it on the deployment controller. If a value is sent here it is refused — and it has been in a request body, so rotate it.
credentials.name: Name
credentials.referenceHint: Upper-case letters, digits and underscores, e.g. LYNOMIA_REGISTRAR_API_KEY.
credentials.maskedHintHint: Up to four characters of a public identifier, such as the end of a token ID. Never part of the secret.
credentials.markRotatedBody: Confirm that the value on the deployment controller has been replaced. Whatever was proven about the old value is forgotten: this drops back to configured, and every provider using it has to be tested again before it can be enabled.
credentials.revokeBody: Nothing may try this credential again. Every provider and machine pointing at it will report a credentials blocker from now on. Nothing is switched off automatically — that decision stays with you. The row is kept so those blockers can say why.
credentials.revokeReasonHint: Recorded in the audit trail and shown beside every blocker this causes.

licences.title: Licences
licences.subtitle: What was bought, what it covers, and when it stops being true. States follow the calendar.
licences.keysGoElsewhere: A licence key that is itself secret does not go here — record it as a credential reference and point the licence at it. This form takes what a person quotes to the vendor: an order or account number.
licences.externalReferenceHint: Order or account number. Not a key.
licences.renewBody: A new term from the vendor. This clears any invalidation, recomputes the state from the new dates and reassesses every provider under the licence at once.
licences.invalidateBody: Record that the vendor rejected this licence. Every provider under it will report a licence blocker with your reason. Nothing is switched off — whether to stop selling onto it is your next decision.
licences.invalidateReasonHint: What the vendor said. Shown beside every blocker this causes.

servers.title: Machines
servers.subtitle: Every physical machine the platform knows about, what it is allowed to do to each, and what it has actually found out. A machine arrives as do-not-touch and stays so until somebody decides otherwise.
servers.registerNote: Registering records that a machine exists. It is classified do-not-touch: nothing will connect to it, look at it or change it until you classify it, one step at a time.
servers.name: Name
servers.safetyHeading: What may be done to it
servers.neverClassified: Never classified. It is do-not-touch by default, not by decision.
servers.classifyBody: A classification can be raised one step at a time and lowered by any amount. Raising it to reimage-allowed does not clear the machine for a wipe; that is a separate decision.
servers.destructiveRung: Reimage-allowed means a wipe can later be cleared for this machine. Type its name to confirm you mean this one.
servers.reasonHint: What you checked. This is kept with the machine.
servers.clearBody: This says that this one machine may be wiped. It does not start anything. It is refused unless the machine is reimage-allowed, and it is withdrawn automatically if the classification is ever lowered.
servers.clearReasonHint: Where you confirmed nothing of value is on it.
servers.revokeClearanceBody: The machine keeps its classification; it may simply no longer be wiped until cleared again.
servers.cannotReach: A do-not-touch machine may not be connected to, even to test. Classify it discovery-only first.
servers.discoveryFoundNothing: The connection was not usable, so nothing was recorded.
servers.noGpus: No GPU device is recorded in this machine.
servers.gpuCountsNote: A device counts as capacity only while it is available, in a mode a guest can hold, and this machine is classified to allow configuration. Recording one does not raise the classification.
servers.gpuPciAddressHint: As the host reports it, e.g. 0000:41:00.0.
servers.gpuPassthroughMode: How it is handed to a guest

passthroughModes.none: Cannot be handed to a guest

providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Every account Lynomia holds with another system, whether it can be tried, whether it has been proven, and the first thing standing in its way.
providers.registerNote: Registering says the provider is meant to exist. It serves nothing until its credential and licence are attached, a connection test has passed and you enable it.
providers.name: Name
providers.notTestableYet: This driver cannot be connection-tested yet.
providers.cannotTest: The {{driver}} driver has no connection tester yet, so this provider cannot be proven.
providers.noCapabilities: Nothing observed yet. A successful test and discovery fills this in.
providers.notReadyToEnable: Enable is offered once readiness reaches ready-for-production.
providers.disableBody: Nothing new will be routed to it. Work already in flight is not interrupted.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.subtitle: What the platform has actually observed, and where nobody has looked.
discovery.nothingObserved: Nothing observed. Run a test and discovery from the provider's page.

readiness.title: Product readiness
readiness.subtitle: Whether the platform may sell each thing, how far it has been proven, and the one thing in the way of the next step.
readiness.ladderNote: A product climbs one rung at a time from what its providers have proven. A controlled (fake) provider carries it to ready-for-test and no further. Ready-to-sell is not something the platform can reach: a person declares it, with a reference to what they validated, and the declaration is withdrawn automatically the moment the evidence goes.
readiness.declareNeedsProduction: Offered once the product is ready for production.
readiness.declareBody: This records that a person validated the product against the real, enabled providers it runs on. The platform checks that it is ready for production right now and refuses otherwise; it cannot check that the validation happened, so say where the evidence is.
readiness.validationReferenceHint: A report path, a ticket, a runbook run. Required.
readiness.reasonHint: What was done, against which account, with what result.
readiness.withdrawBody: The product returns to what its providers currently support. Nothing else changes.
readiness.dependenciesNote: The same evidence, by edge: which provider carries each requirement, and which products lean on which.

softwareNote.complete: Order path, provisioning, customer screen and whole-life test exist.
softwareNote.prepared: Provider contract, capability set and readiness row exist. No customer can buy it yet, and it is capped below production.
softwareNote.readiness_only: Only this row exists, by decree: the platform knows what the product would need and nothing more. It cannot be declared sellable.

readiness.drillNote: Follow a blocker to the thing that carries it: the provider, then its credential or licence, then the machine it runs on. Use the browser's back button to return here.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: What each machine is meant to be, what it would take to get there, and who said yes to exactly that.
plans.noDesiredState: No profile assigned. The machine has no target.
plans.assignNote: Assigning changes nothing on the machine. It records what the machine should be; the plan says what that would take.
plans.overridesHint: Only the keys the profile's components declare, one short value each. Anything else is refused.
plans.clearBody: Nothing is uninstalled. Any standing approval for its plans is withdrawn, because it approved a plan towards a state nobody wants.
plans.nothingToDo: Nothing to do: every component is present.

blockerCodes.safety_class: The machine's classification does not permit this plan's risk.
blockerCodes.reimage_clearance: The plan is destructive and the machine is not cleared for a wipe.
blockerCodes.licence: A component needs a licence that does not permit here.
blockerCodes.dependency_order: The profile installs a component before its dependency.

plans.notApproved: Not approved. The run will refuse until somebody who did not plan it says yes.
plans.approveBody: You are saying yes to exactly these changes, identified by the fingerprint below. If the plan changes in anything, this approval no longer covers it and is withdrawn.
plans.approveDestructive: This plan is destructive. Type the machine's name to approve it.
plans.approveReasonHint: What you reviewed. This is kept with the approval.
plans.revokeBody: The plan stays; it simply may not run until approved again.
plans.runNote: Queues the run. The worker re-checks the classification, the plan and the approval before touching the machine.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.subtitle: Every run, the ones waiting for a person first. A run that stopped without an answer is never retried: somebody looks, and says what they found.
deployments.resolveBody: This run stopped without an answer. Go and look at the machine, then say whether the change is there. The platform records your statement; it does not guess.
deployments.cancelBody: Only a run that has not started can be cancelled.

overview.title: Infrastructure overview
overview.subtitle: The estate as the control plane sees it, and what needs a person first.
overview.nothingNeedsAPerson: Nothing is waiting for a person.

sites.title: Sites
sites.subtitle: Where machines are: datacenters and the racks in them. Registered, never inferred.
sites.name: Name

backups.subtitle: Copies of your servers' disks, and putting one back.
backups.empty: No backups for this server yet.
backups.noMachinesHint: Backups are taken of a server. Order one and it will appear here.
backups.restoreWarning: This replaces every disk on {{hostname}} with the contents of this backup. Anything written since the backup was taken is lost, and the server is unavailable while it runs. This cannot be undone.
backups.deleteWarning: This removes this copy of {{hostname}}'s disks from the datastore. It cannot be undone, and it does not affect the server itself. If this is the only backup you have, you will have nothing to restore from.
backups.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the backup reference below to confirm

notifications.subtitle: Everything we have told you about your account.

categoryHint.security: Sign-ins, password changes and two-factor. Always sent.
categoryHint.billing: Invoices, payments and anything that could interrupt your service. Always sent.
categoryHint.service: Servers being built, suspended, restored or reinstalled.
categoryHint.operational: Planned maintenance and incidents affecting what you run.

preferences.title: What we email you
preferences.subtitle: The portal always keeps a record. You can choose what also reaches your inbox.

console.title: Console
console.subtitle: A direct connection to your server, for when it will not answer any other way.
console.inputPlaceholder: Type a command and press Enter
console.textOnly: This is a text console. Servers that present a graphical console will send data this page cannot draw.
console.noGateway: Consoles are not available on this deployment. Nothing is wrong with your server.
console.refused: That console link has already been used or has expired. Press Connect to open a new one.

planChange.title: Change plan
planChange.subtitle: Prices, credits and effective dates are calculated by us and shown here exactly as they will be billed.
planChange.confirmBody: You will be charged {{amount}} today. Your billing date does not change.
planChange.confirmResize: Your server will be resized. It may restart, and it will be briefly unavailable.
planChange.applied: Your plan has changed. If your server needs resizing, that is under way now and you will be told when it is done.

refusal.different_product: This plan is for a different product.
refusal.different_currency: This plan is not sold in your account currency.
refusal.different_billing_period: This plan is billed on a different cycle.
refusal.same_plan: You are already on this plan.
refusal.not_available: This plan is no longer available.
refusal.would_shrink_disk: This plan has a smaller disk than your server. We do not shrink disks, because it would destroy data.
refusal.subscription_not_running: This subscription is not currently running.
refusal.service_busy: Something else is happening to this server. Try again when it has finished.
refusal.service_not_active: Your service is suspended or still changing state, so it cannot be moved onto another plan yet.
refusal.price_not_for_plan: That price does not belong to that plan.

warning.resize_required: Your server will be resized as part of this change.
warning.fewer_vcpu: This plan has fewer processors than your server has now.
warning.less_memory: This plan has less memory than your server has now. Check that what you run fits.

team.subtitle: Who has access to this account, and what each of them may do.
team.membersSubtitle: Everyone who can sign in to this account.
team.noMembers: Nobody else has access to this account.
team.removeBody: {{name}} loses access to this account immediately, and any API key they hold for it is deleted. Their keys for other accounts are untouched.
team.transferBody: {{name}} becomes the owner and you become an administrator. Only the new owner can hand it back.
team.transferConfirmLabel: Type the account id to confirm
team.inviteSubtitle: They receive a link that works once, only for the address you enter, and only for two weeks.
team.invitationsSubtitle: Offers that are still open, and the recent ones that are not.

roleHints.owner: Everything, including closing the account and handing it to somebody else.
roleHints.administrator: Everything except paying invoices and handing the account over.
roleHints.billing: Invoices, payments and payment methods. Can see the services but not change them.
roleHints.technical: The machines: power, rebuilds, plan changes. No access to money.
roleHints.member: Can see the account and ask for help. Changes nothing.

invitation.title: An invitation
invitation.subtitle: Somebody has invited you to work on their Lynomia Cloud account.
invitation.signedInAsSomebodyElseTitle: This invitation was sent to a different address
invitation.signedInAsSomebodyElse: You are signed in with an address this invitation was not sent to. Sign in with the address that received it, and then open this link again.

support.subtitle: Ask us anything about your account, your services or an invoice.
support.noTickets: You have not asked us anything yet.
support.subject: Subject
support.attachmentsHint: Logs, screenshots or a PDF. Up to five files, 10 MB each.
support.newSubtitle: Tell us what you were doing and what happened instead. Screenshots and logs help.
support.closedExplanation: This request is closed. If you need anything else, open a new one and quote this reference.

categories.provisioning: An order that has not arrived

dns.subtitle: Your domains, and what they point at.
dns.domainHint: The domain itself, without www. Internationalised names must be given in punycode (xn--…).
dns.noZones: No domains here yet. Add one above and this platform will start serving it — once you point the domain at the nameservers it gives you.
dns.delegationExplainer: Point your domain at these nameservers at your registrar. Until you do, nothing here is being served: this platform does not check who owns a domain, and delegating it is what makes these records take effect.
dns.noNameservers: The nameservers will appear here once the zone has been created.
dns.needsAttention: The provider did not answer the last request for this zone, so the platform cannot say whether it took effect. It is being checked; nothing needs doing, and repeating the request could duplicate it.
dns.name: Name
dns.releaseExplainer: Removes the zone and every record in it. Your registration is untouched — this only stops this platform answering for the domain.
dns.releaseWarning: Every name under {{zone}} stops resolving: the website, the mail, and anything else set up under it. This cannot be undone, and there is no delay — it takes effect as soon as you confirm.

domains.authCodeHint: Copy it now. We do not store it, and asking again gives you a new one.
domains.expiringSoon: This name expires soon. With auto-renew on, an invoice is raised before it lapses.
domains.leavingExplainer: The domain is yours. To move it to another registrar, unlock it and take the transfer code — we do not make that difficult.
domains.name: Name
domains.nameserversHint: Between two and thirteen, one per line. Registries refuse fewer than two.
domains.needsAttention: The registry did not confirm the last action on this name. Do not try again — we are checking what actually happened, and support can tell you where it stands.
domains.none: You do not hold any domains yet.
domains.paymentExplainer: An invoice is issued now. The name is registered once it is paid — a registration fee cannot be refunded by the registry, so nothing is bought before your payment arrives.
domains.registrantExplainer: Every registry files a registration against a person or an organisation. These details go to the registry and are stored encrypted here.
domains.searchHint: Type the full name, including the ending — example.com, not example.
domains.subtitle: Search for a name, buy it, and look after the ones you hold.
domains.unknownHint: The registry did not answer. Try again in a moment.

wordpress.adminUsernameHint: Anything but admin. That is the first name every attack tries.
wordpress.awaitingCertificateHint: Your site is up. The certificate is still being issued, so visitors may see a browser warning for a little longer.
wordpress.awaitingDnsHint: The name is not pointing here yet. Change its nameservers at the company you registered it with, and this page will update on its own.
wordpress.domainSource: Where does this name come from?
wordpress.domainSourceHint: This decides what we are waiting for. A name you hold with us points here in seconds; one held elsewhere waits on you changing its DNS.
wordpress.needsAttention: Something did not finish. Please do not order this site again; our team is looking at it.
wordpress.none: You do not have any WordPress sites yet.
wordpress.passwordExplainer: We generate the WordPress password and show it to you once. We do not keep a copy — you can change it from your own dashboard.

sources.existing: A name I already hold here
sources.external: I will point a name I hold elsewhere

steps.verified: We loaded the site and it answered

wordpress.subtitle: Managed WordPress on shared hosting, with the name and the certificate handled.
wordpress.verifiedExplainer: A site is only marked live once we have loaded it ourselves and WordPress answered.

guidance.hardware: Register or classify the machine first.
guidance.credentials: Attach a credential the controller holds, then test.
guidance.licence: Attach a valid licence, then test.
guidance.network: Fix the endpoint or the route to it, then test again.
guidance.configuration: Complete the provider's configuration, then test again.
guidance.dependency: Make the provider this one depends on ready first.
guidance.notImplemented: The product's software is not written yet. No setting moves this; it waits for a build.
